title: Tomato Soup for Dinner
setting: A bright family kitchen in a two-floor house.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Lily and Dad have a conversation about dinner.
sentences.zh: 莉莉和爸爸聊起了晚餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a red T-shirt and jeans, talks with her dad Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) in a sunny kitchen, an empty pot on the table.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily and Dad talking in the kitchen; what they say can't be shown.

sentences.en: That afternoon, Dad brings tomatoes up from the garden.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，爸爸从花园里拿上来一些番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) carries a basket of red tomatoes up the garden steps into the kitchen in afternoon sun.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Dad carrying tomatoes up from the garden; 'that afternoon' is only hinted by the light.

sentences.en: The tomato soup slowly becomes thick.
sentences.scene_prompt: A pot of thick red tomato soup bubbles on the stove, Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a red T-shirt and jeans, stirring it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows thick soup in the pot; the change over time can't be shown.

sentences.en: Some soup falls on her red T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 一些汤洒在了她的红T恤上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A drop of soup falls from a spoon onto the red T-shirt of Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a red T-shirt and jeans, and she looks down.

sentences.en: It is not bad; the colour is the same.
sentences.zh: 这不要紧，颜色是一样的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a red T-shirt and jeans, smiles and shows her T-shirt; the soup stain is the same red as the shirt.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the stain the same red as the shirt; 'not bad' is only in her smile.

sentences.en: But she runs upstairs for a clean shirt.
sentences.zh: 但她还是跑上楼去换一件干净的衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a red T-shirt and jeans, runs up the stairs of the house.

sentences.en: Dad fills two big bowls with hot soup.
sentences.zh: 爸爸把两大碗盛满热汤。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) fills two big bowls with hot red tomato soup at the table.

sentences.en: In the end, Lily is sure it is delicious.
sentences.zh: 最后，莉莉确信这汤很好喝。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), now wearing a clean white T-shirt and jeans, tastes the soup and smiles happily, Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) watching.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily tasting soup happily; 'in the end' and 'sure' can't be shown.
